newsitem.title: CHINA: China says no big change in Deng's health.
newsitem.headline: China says no big change in Deng's health.

text.p: China's Foreign Ministry said on Tuesday there had been no major change in the health of 92-year-old paramount leader Deng Xiaoping.
"There has been no big change in Comrade Deng Xiaoping's health," a Foreign Ministry spokesman told a news briefing in Beijing.

Officials of the State Council, or cabinet, were unable to give the usual official response to queries about Deng's health that he is as well as can be expected for a man of his age, saying they were investigating the situation.
Chinese sources said on Monday that Communist Party chief Jiang Zemin and Premier Li Peng had cut short out-of-town trips last weekend to return to Beijing to visit the ailing patriarch.
